note: something that cannot be done。**名词义**。线索：do the impossible / ask for the impossible。现有中文只有形容词，这个名词义缺失，属新增。

glossEn: not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
note: not capable of occurring or being accomplished。指**事情本身**。线索：an impossible task / physically impossible。

glossZh: （人或行为）难以置信的；荒唐的
glossEn: used of persons or their behavior
note: used of persons or their behavior。**这条的主语是人或人的行为**，所以中文的「难以置信的」「令人无法忍受的」归这条。线索：an impossible person / impossible behaviour
